title: Intake sessions, question engine and conversational mode
story: As a claimant I can report a loss without logging in, by form or free text, in English or Spanish, and see only the questions relevant to my line and loss type.
acceptance: Sessions created, resumed, answered and submitted per openapi /intake paths; channel recorded (web, csr, agent, api); tests/unit/intake/session.test.js

Question engine selects the tenant question set by LOB/loss type and channel, evaluates showIf via ctx.modules.rules.evaluateCondition (fake in tests), validates required/type/enum answers with field-level errors, and returns en or es labels with en fallback; tests/unit/intake/questions.test.js
Adding a question to tenant config shows up on the next session with no code change (test)

Conversational mode: free text uses ctx.ai?.run('extract_narrative') when present else a keyword fallback, prefilling answers with confidence values and never overwriting user-confirmed answers; tests/unit/intake/conversation.test.js covers both paths

submit maps answers to ClaimCreate and calls claims.createClaim (fake in tests), returns claim id and acknowledgment, session becomes submitted and is idempotent on retry; tests/unit/intake/submit.test.js
Claimant self-service works without login per openapi intake security (claimant token from POST /api/v1/auth/token acceptable in dev); no PII in events or logs
tests/integration/workflow/intake-to-claim.test.js runs intake submit against local fakes of claims and rules, using inline sample tenant config
brief: Build src/modules/intake/{index,service,questions,conversation,mapping,routes}.js. service(ctx) per modules.md#intake; tenant config via the tenant-bound ctx (architecture/core-runtime-api.md addendum). Check IntakeSession.schema.json for exact state names and fields. Question shape comes from TenantConfig.schema.json (id, label per locale, type, required, options, showIf, lob, lossType, channels); write a nested-answer path convention (e.g. 'loss.date') in mapping.js and map to ClaimCreate; unknown answer ids must not be dropped silently, put them in extra. Locale: accept ?locale or session.locale; labels object keyed by en/es. Conversational: build a prompt-free wrapper around ctx.ai?.run('extract_narrative',{text,lob,locale}) and tolerate rejection/timeouts by falling back to keyword rules (dates, vehicle/glass/water/fire/theft words, 'rear-ended', 'hail'); returned extractions must be validated against known question ids before prefill. Depend on rules and claims only via ctx.modules and through fakes in tests/unit/intake/fakes.js (rules fake must implement a minimal evaluateCondition for == / in / all / any). Do not rely on the real tenants/ files (authored in parallel by S1-WFL-01); use an inline sample config in tests. Be careful that PII answers are not logged and that events carry only ids. Run only node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/intake/ tests/integration/workflow/.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 26/26 intake unit and workflow integration tests pass; tenant isolation, PII handling, idempotent submit and claimant access verified

escapedDefects.summary: Intake agent role can read/write any session
